en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘The one who wears a ring with the turquoise, would not impoverish his palm’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
’If one uses a ring of turquoise his palm does not become poor.’”
